To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ACF FC packages on FR4 and PI substrates have poor reliability in a salt spray environment.
the LCP substrate performed better than the other substrate materials in corrosive environments.

the reliability of anisotropic conducting adhesive (ACA) flip chip (FC)/package is strongly affected by the substrate type, that the reliability of the LCP substrate is good and that the corrosion behaviour of ACA FC packages is strongly affected by substrate structure and material.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the reliability of ACFs for use in harsh environments and the effect of the substrate material on this reliability.
the reliability and behaviour in corrosive environments of FC packages using ACFs.
the reliability of FC ACF packages in corrosive environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ACF FC packages on LCP substrates are reliable in corrosive environments, but that the reliability of FC packages on FR4 and PI substrates is very poor.
the LCP substrate is the preferred substrate material in corrosive environments.
anisotropic conductively adhesives are not suitable for applications where high humidity or salt spray conditions are encountered.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reliability of ACF FC packages in salt spray test depends strongly on the substrate material.
the reliability of the ACP FC packages with LCP substrate was good, as the salt spray test was very severe, and only 20 % failed during the test.
the LCP substrate performed well in the corrosive salt spray test, while the PI substrate was not able to withstand the test.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the substrate material has a significant effect on the corrosion reliability of ACF interconnections.
the reliability of ACF FC packages in corrosive environments depends on the substrate material.
the reliability of ACF interconnections can be greatly improved by using LCP substrates.
